about: Tier 1 of kyber-genui's composer (docs/reference/GENUI.md, Tiers). An archetype is the question's shape; a source is a query from the vocabulary. Jev picks one of each from these descriptions, code fills the arguments, and bin/lib/genui_tiers.py picks the concrete components from the shape of the data the query actually returned. Nothing here holds data, and every layout still goes through the validator and policy. `connections` is listed so Jev can say a request wants a drawing; no query returns relationships yet, so it always goes to the model.

thresholds.why: Guessed at 0.5, then checked on the frozen 20 only (2026-10-10), never on the sealed set: every source Jev picked at or above it was one a person would accept, and the one request it put under it (#20, a note field, 0.48 for none) belonged with the model. There is no archetype threshold: the archetype only steers which components the math step prefers, so a weak archetype costs a worse arrangement, never a wrong number.

count.jev: one number: how many, how much, an average or a total, possibly with a trend
count.components: Metric for the number; Sparkline under it if there is a series, else Bars when the parts differ

compare.jev: compare the same measure across several things: which class, which day, which person is highest or lowest
compare.components: Bars for one magnitude per thing, Table when each thing has several fields, Ring only for a real proportion

timeline.jev: what is coming up or what happened, in time order: deadlines, exams, events, what is next or overdue
timeline.components: Events, soonest first; a Metric count above when more than six

act.jev: a list of things to act on: replies owed, promises to keep, people to contact
act.components: Table of the fields that differ, or Bars when ranked by days; a Metric count when the list is cut off

entity.jev: one specific thing in detail: a single class, a single campaign or client, a single person
entity.components: a Metric count and Events for that one thing

plan.jev: a schedule or plan for a day or a few days: classes, deadlines and events laid out by time
plan.components: Events for one day; Bars per day for how loaded several days are

breakdown.jev: how a total splits into parts or a proportion: load per class or per day, share done
breakdown.components: a Metric total and Bars per part, or a Ring for a share of a real ceiling

before-after.jev: what has to happen before a milestone such as an exam or midterm
before-after.components: a Metric count and Events with the milestone first (before-exam does this)

connections.jev: how something works or connects: a process, a system, a flow, an explanation that is a drawing
connections.components: a Diagram: a sequence left to right along y=0.5, a hierarchy top down

none.jev: none of these: the request is not for one of these shapes, or is too vague to tell
none.components: a Status naming what has no source, or the closest query's note

due.title: DUE
due.label: Due

overdue.label: Overdue
